messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning a phased sanity run for switching FlashAttention v2 -> v3 in the serving runtime tomorrow (03:00-06:00 PT). Goal: validate kernel selection logic, batch-shaping heuristics, KV cache behavior, and rollback safety. Summary checklist below — please claim owners. :rocket:

alex: I'll own kernel-selection matrix. Plan: run perf matrix for seq_len in {32,128,512,2048} across A100/H100. Capture p50/p95/p99 token latency, overall tokens/sec, GPU SM util, and mixed-precision correctness checks. Also verify fallback order when FAv3 not applicable.

toni: I'll take batching/heuristics. Proposed batch-shaping knobs for the sanity window: dynamic_max_tokens=4096, min_batch_size=2, latency_target_ms=30. We'll run both synthetic microtraces and a small prod-replay (10k requests) to validate tail latency and batching distribution. Watch for batch skew on short tokens.

ryan: I'll monitor KV cache behavior. Recent microchange caused KV hit-rate drop (98% -> 93%) and p95 latency increase ~+18ms on 512 seq. For this run I'll test eviction policies: LRU vs SegmentedLRU, and a conservative 'kv-evict-latch' mode that delays eviction under burst write. Expect to log per-session kv_hits, kv_misses, kv_evictions.

sam: Telemetry/alerting: set up a compare job: baseline=fa_v2_staging, candidate=fa_v3_canary. Trigger an alert if ANY of: p95_latency_delta > 5ms, kv_hit_rate_drop > 2pct, error_rate > 0.1pct, or gpu_oom_count > 0. Also create a short dashboard: p50/p95/p99 tokens, kv_hit_rate, batch_size_dist, kernel_choice_ratio.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: us-east-1, 5 instances, start=03:15 UTC, ramp=10% every 10m, max 60%. Auto-rollback on any alert.

alex: Notes on kernel chooser behavior: chooser picks FAv3 if (model_compatible && seq_len>=pref_min_seq && no_paged_needed). We need to ensure chooser respects runtime-compat and that the fallback path to fused-attn or paged-attn is exercised in the sanity run. Also record kernel_choice_trace per request.

maya: Quick runbook additions: how to manually flip flag, how to force fallback, and how to evict candidate devices from LB. Add steps: 1) Pause ramp; 2) Set feature flag red to 'off'; 3) Trigger rolling restart of canary tasks if stuck; 4) Revert model variant. Attach ticket/PR numbers in doc.

toni: Small check: batching heuristics interact with KV prefetch. If we increase dynamic_max_tokens we may increase KV traffic. For the run we'll enable kv-prefetch=false to isolate batching effects, then re-enable to observe combined behavior.

ryan: Regression hypothesis: a race in KV write path was causing stale inserts leading to lower hit-rate. Tests to run: concurrent-writes stress with sequences of 512 and 2048, verify kv_write_latency and kv_write_retries.

alex: Example feature-flag snippet we'll use (temp):
```json
{
  "feature":"flash_attention_v3",
  "scope":"canary:us-east-1",
  "rules":{
    "initial_ramp":10,
    "ramp_step":10,
    "step_interval_min":10,
    "safeguards":["p95>baseline+5ms","kv_hit_drop>2pct","error_rate>0.1pct"]
  }
}
```

sam: Telemetry query to seed the dashboard (PromQL-ish):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_processing_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, kernel))
/ sum(rate(requests_total[5m]))
```

maya: Ops checklist (short):
- Claim owners: kernel=alex, batching=toni, kv=ryan, telemetry=sam, runbook=maya.
- Pre-run: smoke on staging, correctness eval (deterministic seeds), sample outputs -> eval harness.
- Canary: start 03:15, ramp 10% every 10m, hold at 60% max.
- Monitor windows: p95/p50/p99, kv_hit_rate, batch_size histogram, kernel_choice_trace.
- Abort conditions: any guard tripped (see flag), OOM, or >0.1% errors.
- Rollback: flip feature flag off -> drain canary tasks -> confirm baseline restored.

ryan: I'll add a small KV telemetry tag to differentiate eviction reasons: eviction_reason=[lru|segmented|forced]. Also will log kv_cache_size bytes at 1m granularity.

toni: One more: batch-shaping smoke: run a 1h run with production trace at 5% sampled queries. Check for batch tail ( >90th percentile batch size ) and ensure latency_target_ms holds.

maya: Thanks all. Please post any special commands or one-liners you need in here before EOD. We'll start a short preflight at 02:30 PT to run basic probes. :thumbsup: :warning:
